parameters.name: demanding_modes
parameters.description: Subset of physically demanding transportation modes drawn from the full mode set

parameters.name: transportation_modes
parameters.description: Finite set of transportation modes, indexed by mode $m$

parameters.name: demand_requirement
parameters.description: Minimum total amount of goods that must be transported

parameters.name: trip_capacity
parameters.description: Per-trip carrying capacity for each transportation mode $m$

parameters.name: trip_pollution
parameters.description: Per-trip pollution for each transportation mode $m$

parameters.name: minimum_primary_trips
parameters.description: Minimum number of trips required for the designated primary mode

variables.name: trip_counts
variables.description: Number of trips assigned to each transportation mode $m$

variables.name: mode_selection
variables.description: Binary indicator of whether each physically demanding mode is selected for use

variables.name: total_pollution
variables.description: Total pollution generated by the transportation plan

constraints.name: transport_demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: The transported amount must be at least the required demand using the chosen trip counts
constraints.formula: transported amount is at least D

constraints.name: pollution_cap
constraints.description: The total pollution from all trips must not exceed the maximum allowed pollution
constraints.formula: total pollution does not exceed E^{max}

constraints.name: primary_mode_min_trips
constraints.description: The designated primary mode must be used for at least the minimum required number of trips
constraints.formula: x for M_{primary} is at least L

constraints.name: demanding_modes_at_most_one_selected
constraints.description: At most one physically demanding mode may be selected for use
constraints.formula: at most one y over B equals 1

constraints.name: pollution_definition
constraints.description: The reported total pollution equals the pollution generated by all trips in the plan
constraints.formula: z corresponds to total pollution from all trips

constraints.name: trip_count_nonnegativity_integer
constraints.description: Trip counts must be nonnegative integers for all transportation modes

constraints.name: mode_selection_binary
constraints.description: Selection indicators for physically demanding modes must be binary

objectives.name: minimize_total_pollution
objectives.description: Minimize total pollution generated by all transportation trips while satisfying demand and usage restrictions

final_objective.description: Minimize the total pollution generated by all transportation trips. The problem has a single explicit optimization goal, so no multi-objective combination is needed.
